During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] owned a '''castle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaon]]. 

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] learned that [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] had left the [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mecho-chair]] behind on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] while escaping from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic republic's]] [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|siege]]. He thought about the events leading up to that point.
